item.title: Pinellas Sheriff arrests more unlicensed contractors in undercover Clearwater bust
item.description: More than three dozen unlicensed contractors have been arrested and charged after a two-day undercover operation.

item.title: Tampa Bay nonprofit that helps veterans is still reeling after recent storms
item.description: The first storm flooded most of the cottages offered to veterans. The second storm uprooted trees, which smashed some of what was left.

item.title: Dade City church looking for volunteers, supplies ahead of post-Milton cleanup
item.description: If you’d like to participate in the clean-up, you’re asked to report to the St. Rita Catholic Church at 8 a.m. on Saturday, Nov. 23. The church is located at 14404 14th St. in Dade City.

item.title: Six months post-Milton, Lakeland flood victims still want relief and answers
item.description: “Time flies over us, but leaves its shadow behind.” That quote sums up what Nicole Aldahonda-Ramirez is feeling six months after Hurricane Milton flooded her Lakeland home.

item.title: Pinellas County gives homeowners more time to deal with substantial damage letters
item.description: Many who live in Westwind Mobile Home Park near Dunedin are still being hit with a vortex of stress, anguish, and anxiety almost seven months after Hurricane Helene.

item.title: Bolts fans breathe sigh of relief after dominant Game 3 win
item.description: Tampa Bay Lightning fans are feeling some growing confidence after the team’s Game 3 victory in the first round playoff series against the Florida Panthers.

item.title: Bill named for injured Citrus County deputy, that will fix injustice, passes Fla. Senate
item.description: Current state law only guarantees benefits to officers catastrophically injured during a chase, an emergency, or a criminal act, not while directing traffic.

item.title: Angered by report about Polk County shelter, animal lovers start email campaign
item.description: Animal advocates have launched an email campaign in response to an ABC Action News investigative report.

item.title: Negligence suit filed against Jeffry Knight by passenger involved in deadly ferry crash
item.description: The deadly Clearwater ferry boat crash is now the subject of a lawsuit. It was filed in Pinellas County on Monday by one of the people aboard the PSTA ferry.

item.title: Despite 'productive' summit, Ukrainians in Tampa Bay say ending conflict with Russia will be complicated
item.description: As President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin met for a peace summit in Alaska, some Ukrainians in Tampa Bay said they aren’t optimistic the talks will lead to an end.
